scripts.bundle:server: pnpm check:versions && pnpm --filter @opencord/shared build && node deploy/scripts/create-update-bundle.mjs
scripts.build: pnpm check:versions && pnpm --filter @opencord/shared build && pnpm --filter @opencord/server build && pnpm --filter @opencord/client build
scripts.package:win: pnpm check:versions && pnpm --filter @opencord/shared build && pnpm --filter @opencord/client package:win
scripts.test: pnpm check:versions && pnpm --filter @opencord/shared build && pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=1 --if-present test
